# Senne Vleminckx

[Family Medicine and Population Health, University of Antwerp]{.affil}

I research how nursing teams are put together, how they collaborate, and how that shows up in patient and staff outcomes. I am now extending this work into epidemiological modelling and health economics.

Before research, I worked as a nurse in emergency and intensive care.
